The Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act is a 2005 central law, not one of the 2020 AP laws. The AP Feed (Quality Control) Act and the Aquaculture Seed (Quality Control) Amendment Act are the related 2020 laws, and the AP Fisheries University Act is also of 2020.
